message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel scatter plot comparing task-goal completion across model sizes on AppWorld and BFCL v3, with AgentEvolver highlighted.","description":"The target is a pair of scatter charts with circular model markers and dotted horizontal gridlines. In both panels, the horizontal axis is Model Size, with ticks at 7B, 14B, 30B, 100B, and 235B; the vertical axis is Task Goal Completion (%). The left panel is titled AppWorld and has y-axis ticks from 0 to 50 in increments of 10. The right panel is titled BFCL v3 and has ticks from 20 to 70 in increments of 10, so its displayed y-axis does not start at zero. Model names are printed beside the plotted markers. AgentEvolver-7B and AgentEvolver-14B are emphasized with purple rounded labels and blue dolphin symbols, denoting the AgentEvolver models in the page context; the labels cover portions of the plots, so their values are approximate read-offs. There are no connecting arrows or lines between data points. On AppWorld, AgentEvolver is about 32% at 7B and 49% at 14B; the 14B result is above the other 14B points, and the 7B result is above the other 7B point. Baseline points range from about 2% to 40%; the 32B Qwen2.5-32B point is the highest baseline point, while the 235B Qwen3-235B-A22B point is about 32%. On BFCL v3, AgentEvolver is about 59% at 7B and 69% at 14B, above the baseline points at those sizes. Baseline points range from about 19% to 57%; Qwen2.5-32B is about 50%, and Qwen3-235B-A22B is about 57%. Across the two panels, performance varies among model sizes rather than following a single steadily increasing trend; AgentEvolver's highlighted results are high despite its smaller parameter sizes.
